metadata.method_name: Iteration-5 FREEZE: label-free consensus rescoring screen (V0-V5) + gloss-gated name-free agreement (GG)
metadata.orientation: every predict_* is higher = more likely ERROR; 'NA' = not computed

GG_B_secondary.note: SECONDARY row; does not change GG status

part_A_null.note: within-stratum label permutation of Z; V4 re-cross-fitted on each permuted label vector

FULL_per_E_candidate.note: usd_upper divides the whole sweep (E + PERTURB pairs) by E candidates only

MARGINAL_per_candidate.note: a new candidate needs ~n_peers searches and one gloss call per 12 new mapped pairs; cached pairs cost 0

metadata.E_status: development data; every E number is a development number
